Reviewer suggested splitting the patch into smaller, more manageable sections and possibly reformatting it for better readability

Reviewer Mike Rapoport expressed frustration with the patch description and stated that it broke him, causing him to skip reviewing the rest of the patches.
reviews.raw_body:

rather then instructing claude.

This commit message broke me, I'm going to skip the remaining patches

Sincerely yours,
Mike.

2026-08-13.patch_summary: This patch series improves the coverage of selftests/mm by adding new test cases and modifying existing ones to better reflect the behavior of khugepaged, a kernel component responsible for collapsing huge pages. The changes include increasing the number of test cases from 64 to 256, scaling the collapse wait time with PMD size, skipping certain tests on specific environments, and introducing new features such as folio-order helpers and shared-source write races. Additionally, the patch series includes modifications to existing tests to make them more robust and reliable.
